name: Post-to-Thread Converter
description: Turn any blog post, newsletter, or brain dump into a Twitter thread and LinkedIn post — in the time it takes to ask.
seoDescription: Turn any blog post, newsletter, or brain dump into a Twitter thread and LinkedIn post instantly. Free AI repurposing skill for content creators.
long_description: You wrote the thing. Now make it work everywhere. This skill takes any long-form content — blog posts, YouTube transcripts, newsletters, even rough notes — and turns it into a properly structured Twitter/X thread and a LinkedIn post that actually sounds like you. The Twitter thread is built tweet-by-tweet with a real hook, not a list of tips. The LinkedIn post opens with a scroll-stopper and reads like a real person, not a press release. Two formats, one input, ready to post.
author: CreatorSkills
